items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: My older sister Dallas was playing Keller's Love in that time.

ctx.x: You gotta play without you any time? Huh? You gotta play without you any time?
Yeah, Keller's Love was how Dallas was playing that. My older sister Dallas was playing Keller's Love in that time.
She didn't play that in Cherokee, I bet. No.
